lines: Hi! Kip. Welcome. I'm the Corner Market cashier, the inn's night desk, the volunteer fire safety officer, the pumpkin patch manager and the library's assistant on Thursdays.
It's six. I counted. Twice. Would you like to buy a stamp?
Sleigh ride! Sleigh ride! Hop on when it stops here, all the way round the green!
Job number seven: sleigh ride conductor! Scarecrow Sam drives. He's wearing a scarf now. He's still never once blinked.
Hayride! Hayride! Hop on the wagon when it stops here, all the way round the green!
Job number seven: hayride conductor! Scarecrow Sam drives. He's very good. He's never once crashed. He's never once blinked either.
Corner Market, how can I help? We have milk, bread, and a very nice selection of slightly bent tins.
Fire safety tip number one: don't be on fire. Tip number two: see tip number one.
Snowmen! Build your snowmen here! Big ones, little ones, one that looks like Gus!
Pumpkins! Get your pumpkins! Big ones, little ones, one that looks like Gus!
Shh. Library voice. (whispering) I've sorted all the books by colour. It's very pretty. Miss Marigold made a noise when she saw it.
Maple Inn night desk. Would you like a room? We have one with a view of the green, one with a view of the other room, and one with no view but a very good pillow.

rotate: I'm saving up for a seventh job. Maybe 'town troubadour'. Barnaby doesn't know yet.
Did you know the old oak hums? I measured it. It's a B flat.
